paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper constrains ALP (axion-like particle) decay into two photons via X-ray line search in eROSITA eFEDS data (1.8–18 keV mass range). The coupling g_agamma values were extracted from Figure 7 by reading the eFEDS limit curve. The paper uses DFSZ model with C_agamma = 0.75 and converts the one-photon decay rate limit by dividing by 2 to account for two-photon decay. Data points are approximate readings from the published exclusion curve; exact numerical table not provided in paper. The limit is strongest below 5 keV compared to previous X-ray surveys (Chandra, XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, Suzaku). Confidence level is 95% (one-sided upper limit, Δχ² = 2.71). The paper also presents sterile neutrino constraints and future eROSITA projections, but the primary new measured limit is on ALP couplings from eFEDS data. | selector: text (sole candidate)
